sessions.phase_label: Cover-edit specification and initial Amazon version
Export correction and Amazon upload validation
D2D cover production and final file delivery

requirements.title: Preserve Existing Cover Design
requirements.definition: Limit the work to the requested text, typography, spine, and export corrections without otherwise redesigning the finalized cover.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a global change-control constraint, not an umbrella for the independently testable blurb, typography, platform-dimension, or export requirements.

requirements.title: Trimmed Blurb Replacement and Reflow
requirements.definition: Replace the back-cover blurb with the shortened version and reflow it so it does not overlap or interfere with the barcode.
requirements.boundary_note: Blurb content and reflow form one tightly coupled mechanism; title-font consistency and general exported-text rendering can fail or change independently.

requirements.title: Consistent Title Typography
requirements.definition: Make the title typography on the spine and back cover match the bold gold-gradient title treatment used on the front cover.
requirements.boundary_note: This requirement concerns intended visual consistency; font embedding and corruption-free rendering are a separate export-integrity behavior with their own failure trajectory.

requirements.title: Portable and Corruption-Free Text Rendering
requirements.definition: Ensure exported cover text, including the front-cover tagline, renders as the intended words across viewers by embedding or outlining fonts as necessary.
requirements.boundary_note: The garbled tagline has an independent failure, fix claim, and post-claim failure trajectory, so it is separate from title-style consistency and general platform dimensions.

requirements.title: Amazon Cover Specification
requirements.definition: Provide an Amazon paperback cover variant using the Amazon-specific 300-page template and 0.75-inch spine specification.
requirements.boundary_note: Amazon dimensional compliance is separate from the D2D variant because the two use different page counts and spine widths and have different implementation lifecycles; PDF upload compatibility is also independently testable.

requirements.title: D2D Cover Specification
requirements.definition: Provide a separate D2D-distributed paperback cover variant using the D2D page count and client-confirmed template spine width.
requirements.boundary_note: This variant is independent from the Amazon cover because its 302-page, eventually confirmed 0.68-inch specification is repeatedly deferred and later resumed while the Amazon version proceeds.

requirements.title: Amazon PDF Upload Compatibility
requirements.definition: Ensure the Amazon cover PDF can be successfully processed and uploaded by Amazon while retaining acceptable print quality, with an optimized-size backup when useful.
requirements.boundary_note: Upload processing can fail even when the cover dimensions and visual content are correct, and it has its own failure, optimization claim, and successful-upload trajectory.

requirements.title: Final Editable and Exported File Package
requirements.definition: Deliver the completed cover in layered PSD, PDF, and JPG formats, with the Amazon and D2D PDFs distinguishable by platform and page count.
requirements.boundary_note: PSD, PDF, and JPG are attributes of one delivery package rather than separate Requirements; platform labeling is likewise an attribute needed to distinguish the two cover variants.

requirements.title: Expedited Delivery Timeline
requirements.definition: Return the requested cover edits and files within the initially requested 24-hour window, subject to later client-directed holds for unresolved D2D specifications.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an explicit task-local timing constraint rather than a generic status or scheduling item; later delays are client-directed consequences of unresolved D2D specifications.
